title: Follow the Mean: Reference-Guided Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.10302v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing approaches to controllable generation typically rely on fine-tuning, auxiliary networks, or test-time search. We show that flow matching admits a different control interface: adaptation through examples. For deterministic interpolants, the velocity field is solely governed by a conditional endpoint mean, so shifting this mean shifts the flow itself, and a pretrained model can be steered simply by changing the reference set it follows. We instantiate this idea in two forms. Reference-Mean Guidance is training-free. It computes a closed-form correction to the endpoint mean from a reference bank and applies it to a frozen FLUX.2-klein (4B) model, controlling color, identity, style, and structure while the prompt, seed, and weights stay fixed. Semi-Parametric Guidance builds the same principle into a trained model through an explicit mean anchor and a learned residual refiner, matching the quality of an unconditional DiT-B/4 on

translated_title: 跟随均值：参考引导的流匹配
translated_abstract: 现有的可控生成方法通常依赖于微调、辅助网络或测试时搜索。我们证明流匹配提供了一种不同的控制接口：通过示例进行适应。对于确定性插值，速度场仅由条件终点均值决定，因此改变该均值即改变流本身，预训练模型只需改变其跟随的参考集即可被引导。我们以两种形式实例化了这一思想。参考均值引导（Reference-Mean Guidance）无需训练，它从参考库中计算终点均值的闭式修正，并将其应用于冻结的 FLUX.2-klein (4B) 模型，在提示词、种子和权重保持固定的情况下实现颜色、身份、风格和结构的控制。半参数引导（Semi-Parametric Guidance）通过显式的均值锚点和可学习的残差精炼器，将同一原理构建到训练好的模型中，使无条件 DiT-B/4 在……
tldr: 该论文发现流匹配的速度场仅由条件终点均值决定，因此只需通过参考样本改变该均值，即可在不微调的情况下引导预训练模型实现颜色、身份、风格和结构的可控生成。
